$comment: Shape of jobs/<slug>/job.json — the captured job posting. Validated by validateJob() in src/lib/lib.mjs.

description.description: posting text after src/lib/untrusted.mjs has stripped the known injection carriers — NOT verbatim. It is still third-party data, never instructions (hard rule 0).

untrusted_findings.description: What the posting TRIED. Omitted entirely when clean, so an honest posting's job.json is byte-for-byte what it was before this field existed. It NEVER carries the payload text: an earlier version had a `sample` field that re-emitted 120 raw characters of the attack into the very file the tailoring model reads.

kind.description: e.g. override_instructions, hidden_html, encoded_blob — see DISQUALIFYING_KINDS in untrusted.mjs

fingerprint.description: 12 hex chars of sha256 — correlates findings across postings without reproducing any of the text

questions.description: application-form questions encountered for this job
